nodes.label: Whisper Video/Audio Transcription
nodes.rationale: Video and audio cannot be read directly, so they are transcribed to text and then treated as doc files in Step 3. The JSON sidecar is written from Python rather than a shell redirect because Whisper prints progress to stdout and would corrupt the file. Failures on one file warn and continue.

nodes.label: Self-Composed Whisper Domain Prompt
nodes.rationale: The agent reads god-node labels from the detect output and writes the one-sentence domain hint itself — it is already a language model, so no separate API call is needed. A generic fallback prompt is used when the corpus is video-only. The variable must be exported, not merely assigned, so the child Python process sees it.

edges.source_location: Add them to the docs list before dispatching semantic subagents in Step 3B
